## JARVIS Status v1 - command center data for the JARVIS screen
Real data only: n8n workflows and their runs (n8n API) + JARVIS memory. Teams, scoreboard, items waiting for your yes, agent log, connections.
Credentials: *Webhook* -> **JARVIS screen key**; both n8n API nodes -> Header Auth **n8n API** (Name X-N8N-API-KEY, Value = key from n8n Settings -> n8n API). Save, then Publish. Never click Execute here.
